description: Pull court case filings from the Stark County CJIS portal (starkcjis.org) and build a structured Excel spreadsheet with property addresses. Use this skill whenever Sean asks to pull, download, grab, or refresh courthouse data — whether he says "pull today's foreclosures," "get fresh filings from Stark County court," "update my leads spreadsheet from CJIS," "run the daily court pull," "what got filed today," or anything about extracting new case records from starkcjis.org. Also triggers for phrases like "first to market data," "new filings today," "run the court pull," or "how many foreclosures were filed." Default case type is foreclosures, but also works for other civil case types if requested.
